region.name: the Greenholt
region.blurb: Golden fields in the west, windy sheep-hills and high mountain passes in the middle, and in the east the frozen heights of Frosthold.

towns.name: Lionford
towns.blurb: The royal city of the Greenholt: white walls, red roofs, and a castle flying the Queen's banners.

mayor.name: Lady Olwen
mayor.title: Lady
mayor.avatar: stout lady with silver hair in a bun, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Lionford welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Anything you need, ask. The Queen's champion is welcome everywhere in Lionford.

quest.title: A Bolt of Blue Cloth for Oakwick
offer: Would you carry this bolt of blue cloth to Duchess Ivy in Oakwick? It is for their festival banner. They can't finish it without the blue.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Duchess Ivy in Oakwick is waiting for the bolt of blue cloth.
done: The blue cloth! Now the banner will be done in time.

shop.name: Rowena's General Store

keeper.name: Rowena
keeper.avatar: wood-elf shopkeeper with leaf-green braids and a quiver on her back

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: Ivor's Workshop

keeper.name: Ivor
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Maud
npcs.avatar: small child with scabby knees and a pet frog in one pocket
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
The Heart of Summer can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two jars of summer honey and an ember crystal. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Smith Odette
npcs.avatar: muscular smith with soot-streaked arms and a leather apron
lines: Hammer and anvil, all day long. Look at these arms!
I can build up yours too, for a fee.
Egbert in Mosshollow has an ember crystal, and would give it to a hero.

spots.name: the Old Well
spots.text: You haul up the old bucket. Tangled in the rope is a Rusty Key!

towns.name: Frosthold
towns.blurb: Only the chimneys poke out of the snow, and the townsfolk dig tunnels to visit each other.

mayor.name: Duke Cedric
mayor.title: Duke
mayor.avatar: small, brisk duke with a bushy black beard, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Brrr! Come in by the fire. The Queen heard us!
Hrimgar sits on a throne of ice above the town. If summer doesn't come back soon, nothing will grow this year.

shop.name: The Brave Kettle

keeper.name: Fenella
keeper.avatar: stubborn young shopkeeper with a smudged face and a lantern

lines: I'm staying till the end. Buy what you need; you'll need it.

workshop.name: The Last Forge

keeper.name: Pip
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: Everyone else has fled. The anvil's all yours.

npcs.name: Granny Petra
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Everyone keeps telling me to run. Run where? My knees are eighty-three.
The Sunforge Hammer, the Emberweave Cloak and the Heart of Summer. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Sage
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: I've got four pairs of socks on. My toes are still cold.
Yesterday my eyebrows froze. Today, my ears.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Ironhold
towns.blurb: A mining town behind thick stone walls. Hammers ring from every tunnel.

mayor.name: Duke Jory
mayor.title: Duke
mayor.avatar: tall, thin duke with a bushy black beard, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a gold chain of office
greeting: A hero, in Ironhold! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Watch your step. Our streets mostly go up.

quest.title: The Thunder Eagle
offer: The Thunder Eagle has been prowling the road to Larkcombe, frightening every traveller. Even the bravest carters turn back.
Beat the Thunder Eagle, and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: The Thunder Eagle is still out on the road to Larkcombe.
done: The Thunder Eagle beaten? Then Ironhold owes you a great deal.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Deep Delve

keeper.name: Lark
keeper.avatar: broad-shouldered shopkeeper with rolled sleeves and a flour-dusted apron

lines: Forged in the mountain, cooled in snowmelt. Take a look.

workshop.name: The Stonecutter's Yard

keeper.name: Wendel
keeper.avatar: bearded woodworker with curls of shavings stuck to his jumper

lines: The best anvil this side of the mountains. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Baker Wystan
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: My pies are famous as far as Larkcombe. Well, as far as the end of the street.
The Brass Spyglass from Mosshollow is hidden in the Eagle's Nest in Ironhold.

npcs.name: Guide Dora
npcs.avatar: wiry mountain guide with a coil of rope and wind-burned cheeks
lines: From here the road to Larkcombe climbs, and keeps on climbing.
The quickest road to Frosthold is the one from Larkcombe.

spots.name: the Eagle's Nest
spots.text: High on the cliff, in an empty eagle's nest, lies the Brass Spyglass.

towns.name: Oakwick
towns.blurb: Willows trail their branches in the river, and every house has a little boat tied up outside.

mayor.name: Duchess Ivy
mayor.title: Duchess
mayor.avatar: small, brisk duchess with braided red hair, a plum-coloured cloak, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: A hero, in Oakwick! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Try the bread. Everyone in Oakwick bakes.

quest.title: A Bundle of Healing Herbs for Larkcombe
offer: Would you carry this bundle of healing herbs to Miner Sabine in Larkcombe? A fever has broken out there, and these herbs will cool it.
Miner Sabine has the Sunforge Hammer, and has promised it to whoever brings this.
quest.reminder: Miner Sabine in Larkcombe is waiting for the bundle of healing herbs.
done: Herbs from Oakwick! Bless you. The sick will sleep easy tonight.
I have kept the Sunforge Hammer safe for years. It is yours now: go and put it to good use.

shop.name: Morwenna's General Store

keeper.name: Morwenna
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Best prices in Oakwick! Well, the only prices in Oakwick.

workshop.name: Hester's Workshop

keeper.name: Hester
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Ranger Quentin
npcs.avatar: hooded ranger with a longbow and a scar across one cheek
lines: The wild wears you down, if you let it.
I can toughen you up, if you've the coin.
The Great Crab prowls the road between Coralbay and Oakwick.

npcs.name: Constance
npcs.avatar: lean ferry-keeper in a wide hat, leaning on a long pole
lines: Mind the water. It's deeper than it looks, and colder.
The Heart of Summer can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two jars of summer honey and an ember crystal. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.

npcs.name: Rolf
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: Every hero needs a ballad. Yours is coming along nicely.
The Old Chest in Oakwick is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Well in Lionford years ago.

spots.name: the Old Chest
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Arcana!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest sits in the corner, locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

towns.name: Highridge
towns.blurb: A hill town of orchards and stone walls, with a view over half of the Greenholt.

mayor.name: Lord Tam
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: tall, thin lord with a magnificent moustache, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: A hero, in Highridge! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Have some cheese. Everyone here has cheese.

quest.title: The Silver Bell
offer: Our Silver Bell was stolen! We ring it when the river floods.
A goblin ran off toward Larkcombe with it. Bring it back and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Silver Bell? A goblin ran off toward Larkcombe with it.
done: My bell! Now we'll hear the floods coming.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Crooked Crook

keeper.name: Morgan
keeper.avatar: calm shopkeeper in a green apron, with a pencil behind one ear

lines: Come in out of the wind!

workshop.name: Florian's Smithy

keeper.name: Florian
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Everything I own, I made right here. So can you.

npcs.name: Scholar Nell
npcs.avatar: young scholar with ink-stained fingers and round spectacles
lines: Potions obey those who understand them.
I can teach you, for a modest fee.
The Silver Bell from Highridge is hidden in the Sheep Pen in Larkcombe.

npcs.name: Farmer Agatha
npcs.avatar: wiry old farmer in a straw hat, with a pitchfork over one shoulder
lines: If you're walking to Mosshollow, keep an eye out for a goblin scout on the road.
The crows are bold this year. Bolder than the scarecrow, anyway.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: an Eagle Feather.

towns.name: Larkcombe
towns.blurb: A village of cheese-makers, tucked into a fold of the green hills.

mayor.name: Lord Bram
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: tall, thin lord with a neat white beard, a green velvet coat, and a walking stick topped with a silver fox
greeting: A hero, in Larkcombe! Come in, come in, mind the step.
On a clear day you can see all the way to Ironhold from here.

quest.title: A Book of Songs for Mosshollow
offer: Would you carry this book of songs to Duke Silas in Mosshollow? It is for their choir. They have been singing the same three songs for years.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Duke Silas in Mosshollow is waiting for the book of songs.
done: New songs, at last! The choir will be thrilled. The neighbours, less so.

shop.name: The Woolly Ram

keeper.name: Nessa
keeper.avatar: stubborn young shopkeeper with a smudged face and a lantern

lines: Wool, cheese and cudgels: the three things every hill-walker needs.

workshop.name: The Shepherd's Bench

keeper.name: Bess
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: The forge is hot and the anvil is free. Get to it!

npcs.name: Peddler Basil
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: Word on the road is that Frosthold is in a bad way.
Duchess Ivy of Oakwick is looking for a courier to Larkcombe.

npcs.name: Miner Sabine
npcs.avatar: stocky miner with a lamp on the helmet and coal on the nose
lines: Silver, copper, and the odd bit of gold, if you dig deep enough.
Mayor Una of Coralbay keeps the Emberweave Cloak, and has promised it to whoever defeats the Great Crab.

npcs.name: Farmer Sparrow
npcs.avatar: wiry old farmer in a straw hat, with a pitchfork over one shoulder
lines: Rain's coming. My knees always know.
The Thunder Eagle prowls the road between Ironhold and Larkcombe.

npcs.name: Barnaby
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: My bees make the sweetest honey in the Greenholt.
The Silver Bell from Highridge is hidden in the Sheep Pen in Larkcombe.

spots.name: the Sheep Pen
spots.text: A ram is sitting on something, looking very pleased with itself. It is the Silver Bell.

towns.name: Mosshollow
towns.blurb: Tree-houses joined by rope bridges, high above the forest floor.

mayor.name: Duke Silas
mayor.title: Duke
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful duke with a bald head that shines, a green velvet coat, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: A hero, in Mosshollow! Come in, come in, mind the step.
The trees here are older than the kingdom. Be kind to them.

quest.title: The Brass Spyglass
offer: The harbour master's spyglass is missing, and nobody can see the ships coming in.
A gull took it. It was last seen flying toward Ironhold. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Brass Spyglass? A gull took it. It was last seen flying toward Ironhold.
done: The spyglass! Now we can watch for ships again.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Acorn & Arrow

keeper.name: Ida
keeper.avatar: broad-shouldered shopkeeper with rolled sleeves and a flour-dusted apron

lines: Bows, cloaks, and forest remedies. All handmade.

workshop.name: The Sawdust Hut

keeper.name: Crispin
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Bark, sap and elbow grease. Help yourself to the bench.

npcs.name: Granny Ottilie
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Nettle soup for strength, willow tea for aches. Nothing for goblins, sadly.
The Crooked Crook in Highridge sells honey.

npcs.name: Baker Dunstan
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: Heroes need feeding. You look like you skipped breakfast.
The Brass Spyglass from Mosshollow is hidden in the Eagle's Nest in Ironhold.

npcs.name: Egbert
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: Have you ever fought a wild boar? What was it like?
Can I hold your sword? Just for a second? Please?

gives.line: So you're the Queen's hero! Take this ember crystal, then. They say the Heart of Summer is made with one.

spots.name: the Fairy Ring
spots.text: In the middle of the ring of mushrooms lies a Spider Silk. You hear tiny giggles.

towns.name: Coralbay
towns.blurb: A harbour of bright boats and tarred nets. The fish market opens before sunrise.

mayor.name: Mayor Una
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: tall, thin mayor with a long golden plait, a plum-coloured cloak, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Welcome to Coralbay, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.
The sea gives and the sea takes. Mostly it gives fish.

quest.title: The Great Crab
offer: The Great Crab has been prowling the road to Oakwick, frightening every traveller. The traders have stopped coming, and the market is empty.
Beat the Great Crab, and the Emberweave Cloak, which has sat in my armoury since my grandmother's day, is yours.
quest.reminder: The Great Crab is still out on the road to Oakwick.
done: The Great Crab beaten? Then Coralbay owes you a great deal.
As promised: the Emberweave Cloak. May it serve you well against Hrimgar.

shop.name: The Rusty Anchor

keeper.name: Hugo
keeper.avatar: huge shopkeeper with a braided blond beard and a fur vest

lines: Everything the sea washes up, I sell. Mostly.

workshop.name: The Driftwood Bench

keeper.name: Zinnia
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: Pedal hard and the bellows roar like the sea.

npcs.name: Perry the Slightly Singed
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Ooh, I could do wonders with you. New hair? New cloak?
Magic is cheap. Well, sixty gold. That is cheap, for magic.
Only fire can melt a frost titan's heart.

npcs.name: Old Emery
npcs.avatar: bright-eyed village elder with a knobbly stick and a patchwork cloak
lines: I've seen eighty winters in Coralbay. This one feels different.
Sit a while, Hero. The young are always in such a hurry.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: a purse of 30 gold!

enemies.name: Giant Crab
enemies.taunt: A crab the size of a cart clacks its claws.

enemies.name: Thieving Gulls
enemies.taunt: A flock of gulls swoops down, screaming. One of them has your lunch.

enemies.name: Stone Troll
enemies.taunt: A troll steps out from behind a boulder. No, wait: the boulder IS the troll.

enemies.name: Cave Bats
enemies.taunt: A swarm of bats pours out of the rocks!

enemies.name: Rock Golem
enemies.taunt: A boulder unfolds into a grinding, rumbling golem.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Brown Bear
enemies.taunt: A bear rears up on its hind legs. It smells of honey and bad temper.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Wild Ram
enemies.taunt: A ram lowers its curly horns and paws the turf.

enemies.name: Frost Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf as white as the snowfield pads closer, its breath freezing in the air.

enemies.name: Snow Troll
enemies.taunt: A troll heaves itself out of a snowdrift.

enemies.name: Frost Sprite
enemies.taunt: A shivering sprite hurls a snowball. It is mostly ice.

enemies.name: the Great Crab
enemies.taunt: A crab as big as a cottage rises from the surf, clacking claws like drawbridges.
enemies.avatar: colossal red crab with barnacles on its shell and one claw much bigger than the other

enemies.name: the Thunder Eagle
enemies.taunt: Lightning cracks as the Thunder Eagle dives, its feathers crackling with sparks.
enemies.avatar: golden eagle with wings like sails and sparks crackling along its feathers

enemies.name: Hrimgar the Frost Titan
enemies.avatar: titan of blue ice as tall as a hill, with a beard of icicles and a crown of snow

Duchess Ivy of Oakwick is looking for a courier to Larkcombe.
Mayor Una of Coralbay keeps the Emberweave Cloak, and has promised it to whoever defeats the Great Crab.
The Great Crab prowls the road between Coralbay and Oakwick.

The Crooked Crook in Highridge sells honey.
Egbert in Mosshollow has an ember crystal, and would give it to a hero.
The Thunder Eagle prowls the road between Ironhold and Larkcombe.
The Silver Bell from Highridge is hidden in the Sheep Pen in Larkcombe.
The Brass Spyglass from Mosshollow is hidden in the Eagle's Nest in Ironhold.

Only fire can melt a frost titan's heart.

challenge.title: The Endless Winter
summons: Ah, Hero, you came! Sit, please. I am afraid the news is bad.
Hrimgar the Frost Titan has woken in the glacier above Frosthold. Winter has come in midsummer, and the snow grows deeper every day.
Our scholars say three things can bring Hrimgar down: the Sunforge Hammer, an Emberweave Cloak against the cold, and the Heart of Summer, which holds a whole summer inside.
Find all three, then face Hrimgar at the Glacier Hall. Ask everyone you meet; the people of the Greenholt know more than they think.
Take this purse and these draughts. My carriage will carry you to Lionford. Everwyn is counting on you.

lair.name: the Glacier Hall
lair.text: A great hall carved in the glacier, glittering blue, where the wind never stops howling.

victory: You hold up the Heart of Summer, and summer pours out of it. Snow melts in rivers down the mountain.
The Sunforge Hammer glows like a noon sun. Hrimgar shatters into a thousand icicles, which melt in minutes.
Flowers pop up all over Frosthold. Children run outside without their coats for the first time in months.
